name: Lighting plots
description: Entertainment lighting plots: fixtures hung on named positions (pipes, trusses, booms, floor lines), unit numbers along each position, channels and dimmer or DMX addresses, an instrument schedule, a channel hookup, a legend, and checks for duplicate units, DMX overlaps and overloaded dimmers. Fixtures and positions sit in classes (Lighting-Fixtures-…, Rigging-…).
author: CadCraft
